units: metre; +z up; floor at z=0; aisle C runs along +x

warehouse.floor: sealed grey concrete, worn tyre tracks
warehouse.lighting: high-bay LED fixtures at z=8.5 along y=0.2, every 4 m from x=2 to x=18, neutral white; night shift, no daylight

RACK_C.type: selective pallet racking, orange beams, blue upright frames
RACK_C.lower_levels: loaded with wrapped pallets of cartons, all bays

RACK_D.type: same racking, opposite side of aisle

PALLET_TOP.location: bay C3, top beam level (z=4.5), centred on the bay
PALLET_TOP.load: 12 cartons BOX_01..BOX_12, 2 x 2 per layer, 3 layers, not stretch-wrapped
PALLET_TOP.carton_look: brown corrugated board, printed shipping labels

FORKLIFT.type: counterbalance forklift, yellow body, black overhead guard
FORKLIFT.motion: reversing toward -x along the aisle at walking pace

DRIVER.look: hi-vis vest over dark jacket, hard hat

PICKER.with: CART (two-tier picking cart, 1.0 x 0.6 x 1.0) and RADIO (handheld two-way radio clipped to belt)

SAFETY_LINE.type: yellow painted floor line across the aisle, 0.1 wide

line_dispatch.speaker: DISPATCHER
line_dispatch.text: Aisle C, I heard a crash. Report.

line_picker.speaker: PICKER
line_picker.text: Top pallet came down. Nobody's hurt.
